Read such a record as it is written. A recorded tool result, input or artifact counts as supplied data. When no part is marked as the agent's, everything that is not a background note is the answer. An answer is never absent because of a label, a note or a draft around it.\n\nMethod:\n1. List the distinct conditions the criterion sets: each fact or action it requires and each thing it forbids. A required fact that is contradicted, or limited by an added condition, in what currently stands is violated.\n5. Apply the scope rules the criterion states, as written: which text is the final answer and which a superseded draft, which words are quoted from someone else and which the author asserts or endorses, which event must come before which. Where the criterion states none, everything in the submission counts. A later event never authorises an earlier one.\n6.
